arguments.summary: Investigated the causes of 502s on the checkout page and found that the issue was due to the ingress idle timeout. Also, confirmed that the certificate alert was due to an expired intermediate certificate. Investigated cron drift and found that the issue was with the container running on UTC time and the schedule assuming local time. Additionally, the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing due to job failures, and the table has been exported for the postmortem.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Review and address the root causes of job failures to prevent the backlog from growing further. Notify P09 that the failed jobs have been exported and await further instructions on how to proceed with any flagged items.
